query:
fragment PlaylistFields on Playlist {
    id
    uuid
    boardType
    layoutId
    name
    description
    isPublic
    color
    icon
    createdAt
    updatedAt
    lastAccessedAt
    climbCount
    userRole
    followerCount
    isFollowedByMe
    isPinnedByMe
  }

  query GetMyPinnedPlaylists($input: GetMyPinnedPlaylistsInput!) {
    myPinnedPlaylists(input: $input) {
      ...PlaylistFields
    }
  }
